findings.title: Evaluate the queued timestamp for each AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated when this module is imported, so every AssignmentSource created without an explicit `queued` value receives the same process-start timestamp, rather than the time of its assignment. In long-running webhook workers, the serialized context therefore reports an incorrect queue time for every subsequent change. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to generate the timestamp per instance.
